premises.text: Multichannel selling lifts sales, but merchants avoid it because platform switching and task replication are tedious
premises.evidence_span: Multichannel selling can be tedious, time-consuming, and extremely difficult to manage in real time

premises.text: Syncommerce dashboard centralizes sell/track/manage across channels including bulk listing publish
premises.evidence_span: The Syncommerce centralized dashboard allows online merchants to sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple sales channels simultaneously

premises.text: Automated real-time inventory synchronization updates stock across connected stores when orders arrive
premises.evidence_span: automatically updates the inventory level of the listing on Shopify, reducing it by three, eliminating the need for any manual changes out of stock or overselling

premises.text: Differentiators are SMB affordability, real-time multi-directional sync, and customizable which product data to sync
premises.evidence_span: real-time multi-directional syncing of product data, and the ability to customize which product's data to sync

premises.text: Monthly subscriptions of $40–$200 tier by products and channels; integrations include Shopify, eBay, Etsy, and Amazon
premises.evidence_span: Our monthly subscription ranges from $40 to $200 per month. The three pricing tiers are based on the number of products listed and channels connected

value.text: Sell more and work less through efficient multichannel retailing

secondary_value.text: 190% average sales lift from selling on more than one channel
secondary_value.evidence_span: selling on more than one channel increases her sale on average by 190%

causal_links.evidence_span: affordable and optimized solutions for small businesses

notes: Independent run: folded channel integrations into pricing/commercial premise; kept 190% lift as secondary_value outcome criterion. Revenue traction excluded.
